properties.name: -winui-based-on
properties.description: The WinUI Style this rule is based on (a key such as BodyTextBlockStyle): the rule's declarations are set on top of it.

properties.name: -winui-elevation
properties.description: The depth of the element's ThemeShadow, in px: a WinUI shadow that follows the theme. Units: Native, as written: px, deg, s, ms, fr. No WinUI equivalent (an error that says what to write): rem, em, ch, ex, cap, ic, lh, rlh, rch, rex, rcap, ric, pt, pc, in, cm, mm, q, vw, vh, vmin, vmax, vi, vb, svw, svh, svi, svb, lvw, lvh, lvi, lvb, dvw, dvh, dvi, dvb, cqw, cqh, cqi, cqb, cqmin, cqmax, rad, grad, turn, dppx, dpi, dpcm, x, %.
